module_name: Types of Social Media Data: Text, Image, Video, Interaction Graph, Metadata, Engagement Logs
module_description: Module 3 builds the field dictionary. Students learn to classify data units (post text, comment, image, video, like/share/save, follow edges, timestamps, engagement logs, live-chat bursts, group/channel membership) and to decide tooling per data type. It emphasizes the shift to multimodal data (video with audio + on-screen text + overlay) and to behavioural logs, which is now the default in 2025-2026 industry work.
core_concepts: Data-unit taxonomy: text, media, interaction, metadata, logs
Structured vs unstructured data in platform contexts
Multimodal content as one unit (video + audio + OCR text)
Velocity and scale characteristics of platform data
learning_outcomes: C3 Classify a dataset by data type and choose suitable processing
C4 Design a field dictionary for a chosen API
C3 Explain why engagement logs and text need different methods
methods_models: Feature typing (count, categorical, text, timestamp, network)
Storage decisions (row per post vs row per engagement event)
evaluation_metrics: Schema-design exercise graded by completeness and normalization choices
pitfalls_limitations: Treating a like as equivalent to a comment or share; ignoring recency and timezone metadata; losing deleted or edited content in snapshot copies
tools_stack: JSON/tidy data conventions, pandas dtypes, optional Parquet storage, SQLite for local storage
commercial_platforms: Schema inspection with API console/sandbox (X API v2 object, TikTok object, Reddit submission JSON)
tools_access_cost: Cost of storing raw vs processed data; video data is the largest storage and compute burden
lab_activities: Pick one platform, fetch 500 items, write a field dictionary (field, type, example, meaning, missingness)
datasets_apis: Sample of platform API objects saved as raw JSON plus tidy tables
assessment_methods: Written analysis/design document plus a short quiz; graded on correctness of concepts and quality of justification
data_collection_workflow: Define the question -> choose platform and access route -> collect via API or permitted scrape -> archive raw with checksums -> clean and document schema -> analyse -> preserve dataset and code
textbooks: Russell, Mining the Social Web (O'Reilly, 2019), data-model chapters
Zafarani et al., Social Media Mining, ch. 2
key_papers: Meta Content Library documentation (2024-2026) for archive-scale fields
MDPI 2026 SMATM paper on multi-modal social account topic modeling
trends_2024_2026: 2024-2026: engagement and watch-time logs became first-class analytics objects; video/audio data now needs transcript + on-screen text + gesture metadata
industry_relevance: Social media analyst, market-insights researcher, and data-journalist roles; this module is used for social listening, brand/issue monitoring, and audience research, and is referenced by industry certifications such as Meta Blueprint, Hootsuite Social Marketing, and Google Analytics.
localization_context: Taught with Indonesian-language material (IndoBERT/IndoRoBERTa/NusaBERT, InSet lexicon, Indonesian social datasets) so students can reproduce the analysis on local corpora; comparisons are made against Anglocentric benchmarks whose labels often transfer poorly.
ethics_regulation: Platform Terms of Service, UU PDP No. 27/2022 (Indonesian personal data protection), GDPR for EU-origin data, and IRB-style review for any data involving private individuals; public is not the same as consentable for social data.
case_study_scenarios: Design a dataset specification for measuring how a TikTok campaign performed versus one on X.
